Play your console games on your phone with Remote Play!

Enjoy console games on your Android phone with Remote Play, customizable touch controls and retro gaming features. Use your phone as a gaming screen and virtual gamepad for a compatible console you already own.

🎮 REMOTE PLAY – CONSOLE GAMES ON YOUR PHONE
• Stream games from your compatible console to your Android phone.
• Control games with a virtual gamepad.
• Connect using a supported network configuration.
• Enjoy console gameplay on your mobile screen.

🕹️ RETRO GAMES – CLASSIC GAMING FUN
Rediscover retro gaming alongside your Remote Play experience.
• Explore the app's retro gaming features.
• Enjoy classic-style gaming with convenient mobile controls.
• Switch between Remote Play and retro gaming features.

📱 VIRTUAL GAMEPAD – PHONE GAME CONTROLLER
• Use on-screen controller buttons.
• Move, resize and customize your gamepad layout.
• Adjust button positions and opacity.
• Choose and save layouts that fit your play style.

⚙️ CUSTOM GAME CONTROLLER LAYOUTS
Personalize touch controls for action, racing, fighting and sports games. Set up the buttons around your fingers for a more comfortable experience.

📊 GAME PERFORMANCE MONITOR
• Monitor ping and network latency.
• View FPS, streaming bitrate and packet loss.
• Identify potential connection issues.

🎯 BLUETOOTH & USB CONTROLLER SUPPORT
Connect a compatible Bluetooth or USB game controller when you prefer physical buttons.

🔗 EASY REMOTE PLAY SETUP
Follow connection guidance, customize your controller and start playing games from your own compatible console.

WHY CHOOSE THIS APP?
• Remote Play for console games on your Android phone.
• Retro gaming features in the same app.
• Virtual gamepad with customizable layouts.
• Performance information for your gaming connection.
• Support for compatible external controllers.

IMPORTANT INFORMATION
Remote Play requires a compatible console with Remote Play enabled and a supported network connection. Remote Play does not include console games or offer cloud gaming. Retro gaming content and availability depend on the features provided by the app and applicable rights.

This independent app is not affiliated with, sponsored by or endorsed by Sony Interactive Entertainment. PlayStation, PS4, PS5, DualShock and DualSense are trademarks of their respective owner; names are referenced only for compatibility identification.

Enjoy Remote Play, customize your gamepad and explore retro gaming on your phone!
